name: What should I prepare before consulting a contractor about a room extension?
description: Gather your property survey, identify property boundaries and utility lines, check HOA rules, and determine your practical layout and plumbing needs.

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before consulting a contractor about a room extension?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting a remodeling contractor, gather your property survey or plot plan to confirm lot boundaries and easements. Identify where underground utilities, septic tanks, or irrigation lines run across the proposed build zone. It is also wise to document your goals for the extended space, such as intended furniture layouts, lighting needs, and whether you require added heating and cooling capacity. If your neighborhood has a homeowners association, review their architectural guidelines for rooflines, setbacks, and exterior materials in advance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather your property survey, identify property boundaries and utility lines, check HOA rules, and determine your practical layout and plumbing needs.
